description:
Safely evaluate mathematical expressions with support for basic operations and math functions.

Supported operations: +, -, *, /, **, ()
Supported functions: sin, cos, tan, log, sqrt, abs, pow

expression.description: Mathematical expression to evaluate. Supports +, -, *, /, **, and math functions (sin, cos, sqrt, log, etc.). Example: '2 * sin(pi/4) + sqrt(16)'

name: calc_expression

outputSchema.description: Result of a mathematical expression evaluation.

title: Mathematical Calculator
